notice: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION. All payloads are generated fixtures shaped after pinned public references; they are not real vendor or customer data. Counts below describe this synthetic replay only: they are not field fault-detection accuracy and not a compliance certification.

record_level.denominator_note: Record-level counts use extracted records as the denominator. Deliveries that could not be parsed contribute an UNKNOWN number of records and are counted separately.

metric_level.denominator_note: Metric-level denominator = all emitted observation slots (available, missing, invalid, stale, access-denied) PLUS an estimate of metric slots lost in quarantined records. Unknown data never leaves the denominator. not_installed / unsupported capability states are reported under capability_coverage, not as data loss.

category_legend.defect_repaired: a delivery defect neutralised deterministically (e.g. duplicate suppressed)
category_legend.quarantined: record/delivery isolated with raw evidence; nothing invented
category_legend.unresolved: value or interval left unknown/invalid on purpose (ambiguity, conflict, reset)
category_legend.provider_failure: HTTP 200 carrying a provider failure envelope
category_legend.data_gap: no accepted records for longer than the cadence policy

deterministic_transformations.routine_normalisation_note: Routine unit scaling / sign handling of correct data; NOT defect repair.
